LEGAL NOTICE
PURPOSE OF OUR POLICY

D2C LIFE SCIENCE UNDERSTANDS THAT PROTECTING PERSONAL DATA IS IMPORTANT. WE HAVE ADOPTED THIS PRIVACY POLICY TO SET OUT THE PRACTICES WE HAVE IN PLACE ENSURE THE FAIR AND APPROPRIATE HANDLING OF YOUR PERSONAL DATA.

D2C LIFE SCIENCE  APPLIES THE FRENCH PRIVACY PRINCIPLES THAT SET OUT OUR REQUIREMENTS FOR THE HANDLING OF PERSONAL INFORMATION.

THESE PRIVACY LAWS GUIDE HOW WE COLLECT AND MANAGE PERSONAL DATA, INCLUDING:

BEING TRANSPARENT ABOUT OUR PERSONAL DATA HANDLING PRACTICES
LIMITING COLLECTION OF PERSONAL DATA TO THAT WHICH IS NECESSARY FOR OUR FUNCTIONS
TAKING REASONABLE STEPS TO KEEP THE PERSONAL DATA WE HAVE SECURE.

IN RELATION TO ALL OF D2C LIFE SCIENCE SERVICES, WE DO NOT SELL PERSONAL DATA.

PERSONAL DATA WE COLLECT

PERSONAL DATA IS INFORMATION THAT IDENTIFIES YOU (OR COULD REASONABLY LEAD TO YOU BEING IDENTIFIED).  THE TYPES OF PERSONAL DATA WE COLLECT AND PROCESS DEPENDS ON OUR RELATIONSHIP WITH YOU.  THE TYPES OF PERSONAL DATA WE COLLECT IS SET OUT BELOW:

STATISTICAL DATA – WE COLLECT AND USE ANALYTICS AND COOKIE DATA COLLECTED FROM YOUR USE OF THE D2C LIFE SCIENCE  PLATFORM.  WE COLLECT THIS DATA FROM WEBSITE VISITORS AND USERS.

COMMUNICATION DATA – WHEN YOU CONTACT US, WE USE YOUR PERSONAL DATA TO COMMUNICATE WITH YOU AND ANSWER YOUR ENQUIRIES.

FEEDBACK DATA – WE COLLECT AND PROCESS INFORMATION YOU PROVIDE US ABOUT OUR PLATFORM AND SERVICES.

REQUEST FOR ACCESS AND CORRECTION DATA – WHEN YOU SUBMIT A REQUEST TO ACCESS OR CORRECT YOUR DATA, D2C LIFE SCIENCE  USES THIS DATA TO PROCESS YOUR REQUEST AND COMMUNICATE WITH YOU.

WHEN WE COLLECT YOUR PERSONAL DATA

IN THE COURSE OF PROVIDING OUR SERVICES WE COLLECT PERSONAL DATA ABOUT YOU. WE COLLECT PERSONAL DATA IN A NUMBER OF INSTA
